verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS immigration platform that holds user case data and documents, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows in-platform storage and tracking (e.g. storing an approved visa on the platform). Nothing documents bulk export, open file formats or account exit, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
